blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Understanding how supervision signals shape semantic visual representations remains challenging, particularly in fine-grained, low-data settings. Standard evaluations of vision models rely on downstream accuracy, which often fails to capture structural differences in learned representations. We propose a compact explainability-driven framework for comparing encoders trained with classification-only and caption-generation supervision on CUB-200. Using a controlled two-stage protocol in which both encoders are ultimately optimized for the same classification task, we enable a direct comparison of the resulting representations. Saliency maps are generated using attention rollout and gradient-weighted rollout and evaluated with five metrics covering faithfulness (positive and negative perturbation) and localization (keypoint emphasis, background attribution, and Earth Mover's Distance). Across random seeds and explanation methods, caption supervision yields representations that are more sensitive to the removal of salient regions, better aligned with annotated object parts, and less reliant on background regions, whereas classification supervision produces representations that are slightly more robust to the removal of low-saliency regions. An ablation study on the Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset shows consistent trends across key metrics. These results demonstrate that the proposed framework makes supervision-induced representational differences observable and quantifiable beyond downstream accuracy alone. More broadly, it provides a systematic basis for assessing learned representations and comparing alternative training and transfer-learning strategies.
blocks.zh: 理解监督信号如何塑造语义视觉表现仍然具有挑战性,特别是在精细的低数据环境中. 愿景模型的标准评价依赖于下游的准确性,这往往无法捕捉到所学表现的结构性差异. 我们提出一个紧凑的可解释性驱动框架,以比较经过专门分类和CUB-200字幕生成监督培训的编码器。 使用一个可控的两阶段协议,其中两个编码器最终被优化用于相同的分类任务,我们使得能够直接比较由此产生的表示. 利用注意力的展开和梯度加权的展开生成显著的地图,并用5个衡量标准进行评估,包括忠诚度(正和负扰动)和局部化(关键点强调、背景归属和地球移动器的距离)。 在随机种子和解释方法中,字幕监督生成的表述对清除突出区域更为敏感,与标注的对象部分更加一致,较少依赖背景区域,而分类监督生成的表述对清除低高度区域略强。 对牛津-IIIT Pet数据集进行的一项扩展研究显示,关键衡量标准的趋势是一致的。 这些结果表明,拟议的框架使监督引起的代表性差异可以观察到,而且可以量化,超出了下游的准确性。 更广泛地说,它为评估学到的表述和比较替代培训和转让学习战略提供了一个系统的基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Cross-modal representation learning has become central to modern machine learning, particularly in vision–language modeling. A core motivation is that natural language supervision can provide semantically rich signals beyond categorical labels. Contrastive pretraining approaches such as in CLIP [ Radford et al., 2021 ] demonstrate that aligning image and text embeddings at scale yields transferable visual representations. Hybrid objectives further combine contrastive alignment with generative modeling, as in CoCa [ Yu et al., 2022 ] . Other work studies modality imbalance [ Zhang et al., 2024 , Huang et al., 2025 ] or integrates contrastive and discriminative objectives within unified architectures [ Wei et al., 2023 ] . Despite these advances, it remains challenging to quantify whether different supervision modalities induce systematically different visual representation structures.
blocks.zh: 跨模式的代表学习已成为现代机器学习的核心,特别是在视觉-语言模型方面。 一个核心动机是自然语言监督能够提供超出绝对标签的精密丰富的信号. CLIP[Radford等人,2021年]等相互矛盾的先行训练方法表明,将图像和文本嵌入在规模上可以产生可转移的视觉表现. 混合目标进一步将对比性对接与基因模型结合,如CoCa[Yu等,2022]. 其他工作研究模式失衡[张等,2024年;黄等,2025年]或将对比和歧视性目标纳入统一架构[. 魏等, 2023] (中文(中国大陆) ). 尽管取得了这些进展,但如何量化不同的监督方式是否导致系统性的视觉表现结构,仍然是一项挑战。

blocks.en: Among common visual objectives, classification and image captioning provide distinct forms of supervision. Supervision signals act as inductive biases that shape the structure of learned representations. While classification labels provide discriminative constraints, caption supervision encodes structured semantic descriptions that may encourage different forms of feature organization. While large-scale captioning models such as GIT [ Wang et al., 2022 ] , BLIP [ Li et al., 2022a ] , BLIP-2 [ Li et al., 2023 ] , LLaVA [ Liu et al., 2023 ] , and Kosmos-2 [ Peng et al., 2023 ] illustrate the scalability of transformer-based multimodal architectures [ Vaswani et al., 2017 , Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ] , representational differences are often obscured by scale [ Cornia et al., 2022 , Elguendouze et al., 2023 ] and evaluated primarily through downstream accuracy [ Sariyildiz et al., 2020 , Hu et al., 2022 ] . However, in small-data fine-grained settings, where uncertainty is higher and inductive biases play a stronger role, the choice of supervision modality may materially influence how models allocate attention to object parts and contextual cues.
blocks.zh: 在共同的视觉目标中,分类和图像字幕提供了不同的监督形式。 监督信号是一种诱导性偏见,它决定了学习到的表述结构。 虽然分类标签提供了歧视性限制,但标题监督编码了结构化的语义描述,可能鼓励不同形式的特征组织. 虽然GIT[Wang等,2022],BLIP[Li等,2022a],BLIP-2[Li等,2023],LLAVA[Liu等,2023],和Kosmos-2[Peng等,2023]等大型字幕模型说明了基于变压器的多式建筑的可伸缩性[Vaswani等,2017年;Dosovitskiy等,2020年],但代表性差异往往被尺度[Cornia等,2022年;Elguendouze等,2023]所掩盖,主要通过下游准确性[Sariyildiz等,2020年;Hu等,2022]来评价. 但是,在小数据精细的环境下,不确定性较高,诱导性偏差的作用更强,选择监督方式可能会对模型如何将注意力分配给物体部件和背景提示产生重大影响。

blocks.en: This raises a fundamental question: does caption-based supervision induce measurably different visual representation structure compared to classification-based supervision, even when downstream predictive performance is similar? Answering this requires quantitative metrics and controlled comparisons that isolate supervision modality while holding architecture, optimization, and computational budget fixed.
blocks.zh: 这就提出了一个根本性的问题:基于标题的监督是否诱导视觉表现结构与基于分类的监督有明显不同,即使下游的预测性能相似? 回答这个问题需要定量计量和控制性比较,在固定结构、优化和计算预算的同时孤立监督模式。

blocks.en: Analyzing such differences requires systematic evaluation beyond accuracy. Attribution methods, including Integrated Gradients [ Sundararajan et al., 2017 ] , SHAP [ Lundberg and Lee, 2017 ] , LIME [ Ribeiro et al., 2016 ] , Grad-CAM [ Selvaraju et al., 2017 ] , and attention rollout [ Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ] , provide tools for probing model behavior. However, explanation quality is sensitive to the evaluation criterion. Recent work emphasizes the importance of multi-axis evaluation, assessing explainability across diverse objective dimensions to capture the complementary aspects of explanations [ Kazmierczak et al., 2025 , Kibria et al., 2025 ] . Such multi-criteria approaches are particularly valuable when comparing supervision regimes, where differences often emerge in representation alignment rather than task performance.
blocks.zh: 分析这种差异需要进行超越准确性的系统评价。 分配方法,包括集成梯队[Sundarajan等,2017年],SHAP [Lundberg和Lee,2017年],LIME [Ribeiro等,2016年],Grad-CAM [Selvaraju等,2017],和关注的展开[Abnar and Zuidema, 2020],为调查模型行为提供了工具. 但是,解释质量对评价标准很敏感。 最近的工作强调多轴评价的重要性,评估各种客观层面的可解释性,以掌握解释的互补方面[Kazmierczak等,2025年;Kibria等,2025年]。 在比较监督制度时,这种多标准办法特别有价值,因为监督制度往往在代表协调而不是任务业绩方面出现差异。

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate and quantify whether caption-based supervision transfers semantic structure which remains measurable after subsequent fine-grained classification tuning in a low-data setting. Using the CUB-200 dataset, which provides part-level annotations, we adopt a controlled two-stage protocol. In stage 1, two variants of an identical Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder [ Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ] are trained under different supervision: (i) classification via an attached linear head, and (ii) captioning using a frozen language decoder. In stage 2, both encoders are fine-tuned for fine-grained classification under matched optimization budgets. This design isolates the effect of supervision modality while controlling for architecture and compute.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查并量化基于标题的监管转移语义结构,这种结构在经过随后在低数据环境下细化的分类调整后仍然可以衡量。 使用提供分级说明的CUB-200数据集,我们采用受控的两相协议. 在第1阶段,一个相同的ViT变形器(ViT)编码器[Dosovitskiy等,2020年]的两个变体在不同的监督下接受训练:(一)通过附着的线头进行分类,和(二)使用被冻结的语言解码器进行字幕. 在第二阶段,两个编码器都根据相应的优化预算对精细分类进行了微调. 这种设计隔离了监督方式的效果,同时控制了架构和计算.

blocks.en: To compare representation properties beyond predictive performance, we evaluate attribution behavior using attention rollout and gradient-augmented attention methods. We further introduce a structured evaluation protocol integrating five explainability metrics across two categories: localization, measured by keypoint emphasis, background fraction, and distributional alignment via Earth Mover’s Distance (EMD); and faithfulness, measured by perturbation AUC under positive and negative masking. Leveraging CUB’s part annotations enables objective quantification of semantic alignment. An overview of the proposed framework is presented in Figure 1 . We further assess robustness through two ablations: a cross-dataset evaluation on a second fine-grained benchmark and an encoder-scale ablation using a larger ViT from the same architectural family.
blocks.zh: 为了比较预测性能以外的表达性能,我们使用关注展开和梯度增强的注意方法来评价归属行为. 我们进一步引入一个结构化的评价协议,将五种可解释性衡量标准包含在两类中:局部化,以关键点重点、背景分量和通过地球移动者距离(EMD)进行分布相接来衡量;以及忠诚度,以扰动AUC在正面和负面相遮来衡量。 利用CUB的部分说明,可以客观地量化语义上的对齐. 图1概述了拟议框架。 我们通过两种方法进一步评估稳健性:对第二个精细分量基准进行跨数据集评价,以及使用同一建筑家族更大的维特分量进行编码器尺度分量。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of the proposed two-stage training and evaluation framework. (a) Stage 1 performs task-specific base tuning via either classification or captioning objectives. (b) Stage 2 applies controlled downstream finetuning for fine-grained classification using identical optimization budgets. (c) Explainability evaluation is conducted using multi-criteria metrics including perturbation-based faithfulness and localization measures.
blocks.zh: 图1:拟议的两阶段培训和评价框架概览。 (a) 第1阶段通过分类或标题目标进行具体任务的基础调整。 (b) 第2阶段采用控制下游微调,采用相同的优化预算进行精细分类。 (c) 使用多标准衡量标准进行解释性评估,包括基于扰动的忠诚度和本地化措施。

blocks.en: Empirically, we find that caption-based pretraining produces consistent and reproducible differences in attribution structure, including stronger correspondence to annotated keypoints, improved geometric alignment with keypoint density maps, and reduced attribution to background regions. These trends persist across attribution methods, datasets, and encoder scales, suggesting that language supervision can shape visual representations in ways that are not reflected by classification accuracy alone. Although caption-based pretraining does not improve downstream accuracy under fixed computational budgets, the explainability-based analysis reveals a more general implication: supervision modality can affect the semantic organization of learned representations independently of predictive risk. Our results therefore position multi-criteria attribution evaluation as a useful tool for quantifying representation transfer beyond task performance.
blocks.zh: 从经验上讲,我们发现,基于标题的预训在归属结构上产生一致和可复制的差异,包括加强与附加说明的指针的对应,与指针密度图的几何相接,以及对背景区域的归属减少。 这些趋势在归属方法,数据集和编码器尺度上持续存在,说明语言监督可以形成视觉表达,其方式不能仅通过分类精度来反映. 虽然基于标题的预训并不能提高固定计算预算下的下游准确性,但基于解释性的分析揭示出一个更普遍的含义:监督方式可以独立于预测风险而影响学到的表述的语义组织. 因此,我们的成果将多标准归属评价定位为将代表性转移量化于任务业绩之外的有用工具。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Language supervision has been used to enrich visual representations in fine-grained settings such as CUB-200. Hendricks et al. [2016] connected caption generation with grounded visual explanations, while Reed et al. [2016] learned joint image–text embeddings that improved retrieval and zero-shot classification. Similarly, He and Peng [2017] proposed a two stream model, separately trained for vision and language supervision for learning robust semantic representations. These works demonstrate that textual supervision can shape transferable features.
blocks.zh: 语言监督被用于丰富CUB-200等细纹环境下的视觉表现. Hendricks等 [2016] 将标题生成与被基于的视觉解释联系起来,而Reed等. [2016] 学习了联合图像-文本嵌入,改善了检索和零镜头分类. 同样, 他与彭[2017]提出"双流"模式,分别接受视觉和语言监督培训,以学习强健的语义表现. 这些作品表明,文字监督可以塑造可转移的特征.

blocks.en: More recent multimodal representation learning studies including large-scale vision–language pretraining and contrastive objectives further show the potential of cross-modal transfers such as induction of semantically dense and localization-aware representations [ Radford et al., 2021 , Desai and Johnson, 2021 , Li et al., 2022b , El Banani et al., 2023 ] . However, most studies evaluate such representations through downstream transfer performance, large-scale pretraining effectiveness, or task accuracy improvements, leaving open the question of how language supervision alters semantic alignment under controlled training budgets in small-data regimes.
blocks.zh: 较近期的多模式表述学习研究,包括大规模愿景-语言前培训和对比目标,进一步表明跨模式转移的潜力,如诱导精密的本地化表述[Radford等,2021年;Desai和Johnson,2021年;Li等,2022年b;El Banani等,2023年]。 然而,大多数研究都通过下游转移业绩、大规模预训效果或任务准确性改进来评价这种表述,因此,对于语言监督如何改变小数据制度中受控制的培训预算下的语义一致性的问题,没有定论。

blocks.en: Language-based supervision has also been studied in reasoning and multitask settings. The VCR benchmark [ Zellers et al., 2019 ] highlights the role of language in grounding visual reasoning. Parelli et al. [2023] distill reasoning supervision into visual models and report improvements in task-aligned faithfulness measures. Similarly, Najjar et al. [2025] show that auxiliary tasks can improve interpretability when strongly correlated with the primary objective. In contrast, we consider caption supervision applied only during pretraining and removed at evaluation time, enabling analysis of cross-modal transfer effects without explicit auxiliary objectives during classification.
blocks.zh: 在推理和多任务设置方面也研究了基于语言的监督. VCR基准[Zellers等,2019]突出了语言在打地平视推理中的作用. 帕雷利等编. [2023]将推理监督分解入视觉模型,并报告任务相匹配的忠诚度措施的改进. 同样地,Najjar等人也提到过。 [2025] 显示辅助任务在与主要目标紧密相联时可以提高可解释性. 相反,我们认为,标题监督只在预训期间适用,并在评估时取消,从而能够分析跨模式转让的效果,而在分类时没有明确的辅助目标。

blocks.en: For transformer-based models, attention-driven attribution methods such as attention rollout [ Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ] and gradient-based localization [ Selvaraju et al., 2017 , Chefer et al., 2021 ] provide tools to probe learned representations. However, explainability is often evaluated using a single metric or qualitative inspection. Recent work argues that systematic evaluation of explainability should involve multi-dimensional analysis to account for their multi‑faceted and subjective nature [ Nauta et al., 2023 , Kibria et al., 2025 ] .
blocks.zh: 对于基于变压器的模型,注意力驱动的归属方法如注意力推出[Abnar and Zuidema, 2020]和基于梯度的本地化[Selvaraju等, 2017年; Cefer等, 2021] 提供了探索所学到的表示力的工具. 然而,解释性往往通过单一的衡量或质量检查加以评估。 最近的工作认为,对可解释性的系统评估应涉及多维分析,以考虑到其多面性和主观性[Nauta等,2023年;Kibria等,2025年]。

blocks.en: Overall, prior work establishes that language supervision can improve transfer performance. Our contribution is to examine, under matched architectures and compute, whether caption-based pretraining induces measurable differences in representation alignment in low-data fine-grained settings.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,以前的工作确定,语言监督可以改善转移性能。 我们的贡献是,在匹配的架构和计算下,审查基于标题的预训是否会导致在低数据精细配置环境中在表示一致性方面的可衡量差异。

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: This section describes the dataset, training protocols, explanation methods, and the proposed explainability evaluation framework.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍数据集、培训规程、解释方法和拟议解释性评价框架。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: We conduct experiments on the CUB-200-2011 dataset, which contains 11,788 images across 200 bird species and is widely used for fine-grained visual classification. In addition to class labels, the dataset provides object bounding boxes and 15 annotated part keypoints per image. These keypoints correspond to semantically meaningful bird parts (e.g., beak, wing, tail) and are commonly used to evaluate part-level localization. The dataset also includes binary attribute annotations and segmentation masks. Fine-grained visually descriptive captions without including the species or the background have been constructed in prior work for the dataset [ Reed et al., 2016 ] and are used in this study for caption supervision. Further details regarding dataset annotations are provided in Appendix 8 .
blocks.zh: 我们进行CUB-200-2011数据集的实验,该数据集包含有包含200个鸟类物种的11,788个图像,被广泛用于细纹视觉分类. 除了类标签外,数据集还提供对象边框和每个图像有15个注释的部分键点. 这些关键点对应了有分泌意义的鸟类部分(如喙,翼,尾等),并被通俗地用于评价部分地层化. 数据集还包括二进制属性说明和分块口罩. 在之前的数据集工作[Reed等,2016年]中已经构建了细纹可视化描述性字幕,但没有包含物种或背景,本研究中用于标题监管. 关于数据集说明的进一步详情见附录8。

blocks.en: 3.2 Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 模式

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of supervision modality, we compare two training variants that differ only in the objective used during the first stage (Stage 1) of pretraining. Both variants share the same vision backbone: a Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) initialized with ImageNet pretraining.
blocks.zh: 为了评估监督方式的效果,我们比较了两个培训变体,它们仅在第一阶段(第1阶段)预训中使用的目标上有所不同。 两个变体都具有相同的视觉主干:一个用ImageNet预训初始化的ViT-B/16.

blocks.en: We note that ImageNet contains certain bird categories that may overlap semantically with CUB-200 classes. While exact image overlap is not present, this semantic proximity may influence representation transfer. However, this factor is not expected to confound our comparison because ImageNet initialization is held fixed across all experimental conditions, therefore, is used as a controlled common starting point to ensure stable optimization in the low-data regime; in contrast, training from scratch leads to substantially reduced performance and unstable convergence.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,ImageNet中包含某些鸟类类别,它们可能与CUB-200类相重叠。 虽然准确的图像重叠不存在,但这种语义相近可能影响代表的转移. 然而,这一因素预计不会使我们的比较出现混乱,因为ImageNet初始化在所有实验条件下都固定不变,因此被用作控制下的共同起点,以确保低数据制度的稳定优化;相反,从零开始的培训导致性能被大幅度降低并不稳定地趋同。

blocks.en: In the first variant, the encoder is trained with a standard classification objective by attaching a multi-layer perceptron (MLP) head to the [CLS] token representation.
blocks.zh: 在第一个变体中,编码器通过将多层受体(MLP)头接入[CLS]符号代表符来进行标准分类目标的培训.

blocks.en: In the second variant, caption supervision is introduced by attaching a pretrained GPT-2 decoder [ Radford et al., 2019 ] to the encoder through cross-attention layers. During Stage 1 training, most of the decoder parameters are frozen except the cross-attention weights, and the vision encoder is updated. This design isolates the effect of textual supervision on visual representations while preventing adaptation within the language model. Since the decoder is used only during Stage 1 training and primarily in the forward pass, with limited parameter updates, the additional computational overhead remains moderate.
blocks.zh: 在第二个变体中,通过交叉意向层在编码器上附加了经过预训的GPT-2解码器[拉德福德等,2019年]来引入了标题监管. 在第一阶段的训练中,除相向分量外,大部分解码器参数被冷冻,视觉编码器被更新. 这种设计隔离了文字监督对视觉表现的影响,同时防止了语言模型内的适应. 由于解码器只在第一阶段培训期间使用,并主要用于前行通道,但参数更新有限,额外计算间接费用仍然适度.

blocks.en: In the second stage (Stage 2), both encoder variants are fine-tuned for downstream fine-grained classification under identical optimization settings. In this stage, a classification MLP head is trained on top of the encoder ([CLS] token representation), and no caption loss is applied. The overall two-stage architecture is illustrated in Figure 1 (a-b).
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段(Stage 2)中,两种编码器变体在相同的优化设置下为下游精细分级进行微调. 在这一阶段,在编码器上方([CLS]令牌代表)训练出一个分类的MLP头,没有应用标题丢失. 图1(a-b)说明了整个两阶段建筑。

blocks.en: 3.3 Explanation Algorithms
blocks.zh: 3.3 解释法

blocks.en: To analyze representation differences beyond predictive accuracy, we employ attribution methods tailored to transformer-based architectures.
blocks.zh: 为了分析表达差异超出预测精确度,我们采用了适合变压器结构的归属方法.

blocks.en: We apply attention rollout [ Abnar and Zuidema, 2020 ] , which aggregates attention weights across layers to estimate token-level influence. This method relies solely on forward-pass attention maps and produces class-agnostic attribution scores. Given that each image in CUB-200 contains a single labeled object, class-agnostic saliency remains informative for assessing spatial focus.
blocks.zh: 我们应用了注意的展开[Abnar and Zuidema, 2020],它集聚了各层的注意力分量来估计符号级的影响. 这种方法完全依靠前传的注意地图,产生阶级不可知的归属分数. 鉴于CUB-200中的每个图像都包含一个被标注的单一物体,类不可知性仍然为评估空间焦点提供信息。

blocks.en: We additionally employ the transformer attribution method inspired from the work of Chefer et al. [2021] , which combines attention weights with gradients of the target logit with respect to attention scores. This approach introduces class-specific information into the attribution and is conceptually related to gradient-based localization methods such as Grad-CAM [ Selvaraju et al., 2017 ] . By incorporating gradient signals, the resulting saliency maps reflect the contribution of image regions to the predicted class.
blocks.zh: 我们还采用了从Cefer等人的工作中得到启发的变压器归属方法。 [2021],它结合了注意力权重与目标对数对注意力分数的梯度. 这种方法将特定类别的信息引入了归属,在概念上与梯度本地化方法相关,如Grad-CAM [Selvaraju等,2017]. 通过收录梯度信号,由此而来的重要地图反映了图像区域对预测类的贡献.

blocks.en: The detailed mathematical formulation of both adapted algorithms is provided in Appendix 9 .
blocks.zh: 附录9提供了两种经调整算法的详细数学配方。

blocks.en: Using both methods allows us to distinguish between general spatial attention patterns and class-conditional feature attribution, which is essential for evaluating representational differences induced by supervision modality.
blocks.zh: 使用这两种方法使我们能够区分一般的空间关注模式和类条件特征归属,这对于评估监督方式引起的代表差异至关重要。

blocks.en: 3.4 Explanation Evaluation
blocks.zh: 3.4 评价

blocks.en: Evaluating explanations requires multiple complementary criteria, as no single metric fully captures explanatory quality. We therefore assess explanations along two objective dimensions: faithfulness and localization . Faithfulness quantifies the extent to which saliency values reflect the true contribution of input regions to the model’s prediction, while localization evaluates the spatial correspondence between saliency and annotated semantic structure. All metrics are computed identically across supervision variants.
blocks.zh: 评价解释需要多种补充标准,因为没有单一的衡量标准能够充分反映解释性的质量。 因此,我们按照两个客观方面来评估解释:忠诚和本地化。 忠诚度量化了显著值反映输入区对模型预测的真正贡献的程度,而局部化则评价显著和注释语义结构之间的空间对应. 所有衡量标准均按不同的监管变量计算。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: This section details the training protocol, experimental setup, and associated hyperparameters.
blocks.zh: 本节详述了训练规程,实验设置,以及相关的超参数.

blocks.en: 4.1 Training Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训设置

blocks.en: Experiments were conducted on a single cluster node equipped with four NVIDIA V100 GPUs. Image captioning models were trained using the Huggingface API, enabling seamless multi-GPU training, while classification models were trained using PyTorch.
blocks.zh: 在一个配备了4个NVIDIA V100 GPU的单一集群节点上进行了实验. 图像字幕模型被使用Huggingface API进行训练,实现了无缝多GPU训练,而分类模型则使用PyTorch进行训练.

blocks.en: We use the CUB-200 dataset with 11,788 images, split into training, validation, and test subsets with proportions 50.9%, 24.7%, and 24.4%, respectively. For caption supervision, we use the Reed et al. [2016] caption extension, which provides ten natural-language descriptions per image, resulting in ten image–caption pairs for each image while preserving the same image-level splits used for classification. Captions are tokenized with the pretrained GPT-2 tokenizer, and images are processed using the standard ViT preprocessing pipeline [ Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们使用CUB-200数据集,包含11,788个图像,分为训练,验证,测试子集,比例分别为50.9%,24.7%和24.4%. 在字幕监督方面,我们使用Reed等人. [2016] 标题扩展,每幅图像提供十种自然语言描述,结果每个图像有十种图像-封装对,同时保留用于分类的同一种图像平分. Captions以被预训的GPT-2的活化剂为标志,并使用标准的Vit预处理管处理图像[Dosovitskiy等,2020].

blocks.zh: 4.2 培训议定书

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Stage 1: Base Encoder Tuning
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 第1阶段:基础编码器

blocks.en: During the first stage of training, two encoder variants are produced. Hyperparameters were chosen based on informed intuition and resulting experimentation without aiming for exhaustive optimization, as the optimal values are not crucial for the primary objectives of this study.
blocks.zh: 在培训的第一阶段,制作了两个编码器变体. 选择超参数是基于知情的直觉和由此而来的实验,而无意进行详尽的优化,因为最佳值对本研究的主要目标并不至关重要。

blocks.en: The ImageNet-pretrained ViT is fine-tuned on CUB-200 for five iterations with a smaller learning rate for the encoder ( 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} ) and a larger rate for the classification head ( 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} ), enabling gradual adaptation of the backbone. Figure 2 shows the evolution of training and validation loss, and test accuracy averaged over three seeds with 95% confidence intervals (CI). The final iteration achieves a mean test accuracy of 0.8454 ± 0.0148, with the highest mean accuracy observed at iteration 3.

Similar to the first variant, a smaller learning rate of 3 × 10 − 5 3\times 10^{-5} is employed to train the encoder with a cross-entropy loss on the token outputs. Due to the limited diversity of captions in the dataset and the partial fine-tuning of the pipeline, the resulting captions exhibit only moderate quality, as illustrated in Figure 3 . Nevertheless, for the purposes of this study, the injection of external knowledge is prioritized over maximizing captioning accuracy.

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We analyze the impact of the two training regimes beyond classification accuracy using explainability-oriented metrics computed over the test set across three random seeds. To assess whether supervision modality induces measurable differences in visual concept utilization, we report both quantitative analysis and qualitative trends.
blocks.zh: 我们通过在三个随机种子的测试中计算出以解释性为导向的衡量标准,分析两种培训制度的影响,超越分类准确性。 为了评估监督方式是否导致视觉概念利用方面的可衡量差异,我们报告定量分析和定性趋势。

blocks.en: 5.1 Perturbation-based Evaluation of Explanations
blocks.zh: 5.1 对解释的评估

blocks.en: We first evaluate explanation faithfulness using perturbation-based analysis. Following prior work, image regions are progressively masked according to saliency rankings while tracking the model’s predicted probability for the ground-truth class. We consider positive and negative perturbations.
blocks.zh: 我们首先通过基于扰动的分析来评价解释的忠实性. 继先前的工作之后,图像区域在跟踪模型预测的地真相类概率的同时,根据显著的排名逐渐被掩盖. 我们认为积极和消极的干扰。

The curves reflect explanation faithfulness in terms of sensitivity (positive perturbation) and robustness (negative perturbation).

blocks.en: Under negative perturbation, both encoders exhibit nearly similar stability across masking levels, indicating regions identified as minimally important can be removed without substantial degradation in predictive confidence. This suggests comparable robustness in discarding low-saliency regions, with the classification-tuned encoder showing a slight advantage.
blocks.zh: 在负扰动下,两种编码器在遮掩水平上呈现出近乎相近的稳定性,表明被确定为最低重要性的区域可以在不发生预测性信心严重退化的情况下被移除. 这表明在丢弃低高度区域方面具有类似的稳健性,分类调整编码器显示出轻微的优势.

blocks.en: In contrast, under positive perturbation, the caption-tuned encoder shows a consistently steeper decline in confidence as salient regions are progressively removed. This pattern appears across both attention-based and gradient-weighted explanations and persists throughout masking levels. The sharper degradation indicates that the caption-tuned model concentrates predictive mass on regions identified as salient, consistent with improved faithfulness.
blocks.zh: 与此相反,在正扰动下,标题调整编码器显示,随着显著区域被逐渐清除,信任度持续急剧下降。 这种模式在基于关注和梯度加权的解释中都有所体现,并在整个遮掩水平上持续存在。 更严重的退化表明,经过标题调整的模型将预测质量集中在被确定为突出的区域,这与提高的忠诚度相一致。

blocks.en: Overall, these results suggest that caption supervision does not primarily increase reliance on contextual cues. Instead, it promotes stronger dependence on a smaller set of semantically meaningful regions, such that removing them results in a pronounced performance drop. While this increased sensitivity reflects improved alignment between saliency and model reliance, it does not imply enhanced robustness to distribution shift or adversarial perturbations, which remain open questions.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果表明,标题监督并不主要增加对背景提示的依赖。 相反,它促使人们更加依赖规模较小的具有实质意义的区域,从而消除这些区域,导致业绩明显下降。 虽然这种敏感性的提高反映了优势和模式依赖之间的更趋一致,但这并不意味着分配转移或对抗性扰动的强性得到增强,而这些问题仍然是有待解决的问题。

blocks.en: 5.2 Localization-based Evaluation of Explanations
blocks.zh: 5.2 基于本地化的解释评价

These metrics compare saliency maps against ground-truth keypoint annotations and segmentation masks from complementary perspectives. For each seed, scores are averaged over the test set, yielding one aggregate value per training regime.

blocks.en: Collectively, these results indicate that caption supervision systematically biases representations toward foreground-centric and semantically grounded explanations. The consistency of these effects across two attribution methods and multiple seeds suggests that the observed improvements arise from the training objective rather than artifacts of a particular saliency algorithm.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,标题监督有系统地偏向于以前景为中心、以整体为基础的解释。 两种归属方法和多种种子之间这些效应的一致性表明,观察到的改进来自培训目标,而不是某种特殊优势算法的文物。

blocks.en: 5.4 Qualitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 5.4 定性比较

blocks.en: To complement quantitative analysis, we present representative test images with predicted labels and overlaid saliency maps for both training regimes and explanation methods in Figure 7 .
blocks.zh: 为了补充定量分析,我们在图7中提供了具有代表性的测试图像,其中附有预测的标签和覆盖的显著性地图,用于培训制度和解释方法。

blocks.en: Across examples, gradient-weighted rollout exhibits higher-frequency artifacts, particularly in background regions, likely due to the sensitivity of gradients and upsampling from patch to pixel resolution. Attention rollout produces smoother, more spatially coherent maps.
blocks.zh: 在各种例子中,梯度加权的推出显示了高频文物,特别是在背景地区,这可能是由于梯度的敏感性和从补丁到像素分辨率的提升。 注意的展开产生更平滑,空间更连贯的地图.

blocks.en: Comparing training regimes, differences are subtle but consistent with quantitative trends. Caption-tuned models show reduced background activation and more spatially concentrated attributions, particularly under gradient-weighted rollout. This pattern appears for both correct and incorrect predictions, suggesting a structural shift in how evidence is distributed rather than a byproduct of accuracy differences.
blocks.zh: 比较培训制度,差异是微妙的,但与数量趋势是一致的。 Caption-tuned模型显示背景活性减少和空间更集中的归属,特别是在梯度加权的推出下. 这种模式似乎既用于正确的预测,也用于不正确的预测,这表明证据如何分配的结构转变,而不是准确性差异的副产品.

blocks.en: While qualitative maps support the statistical findings, they should be interpreted cautiously given the non-causal nature of saliency methods. Conclusions rely primarily on systematic quantitative evaluation.
blocks.zh: 虽然定性地图支持统计结果,但鉴于显要方法的非因果性质,应当谨慎解释。 结论主要依靠系统的定量评价。

blocks.en: 6 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 6 阅读研究

blocks.en: We conduct two ablation studies to examine whether the trends observed on CUB-200 are robust to changes in dataset and model capacity. First, we evaluate the same protocol on the Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset, which provides a second fine-grained recognition setting with foreground segmentation masks. Second, we repeat the CUB-200 experiment using a larger ViT-L/16 encoder to test whether the attribution trends persist beyond a single encoder scale.
blocks.zh: 我们进行了两项减速研究,以审查所观察到的CUB-200上的趋势对数据集和模型容量的变化是否有力。 首先,我们在牛津-IIIT Pet数据集上评价同样的协议,它提供了第二个有前地分层口罩的精细分层识别设置. 其次,我们重复CUB-200的实验,使用更大的VIT-L/16编码器来测试归属趋势是否持续在单个编码器尺度之外.

blocks.en: 6.1 Results on the Oxford-IIIT Pet Dataset
blocks.zh: 6.1 Oxford-IIIT Pet数据集的结果

blocks.en: The Oxford-IIIT Pet dataset contains 37 fine-grained pet categories, comprising 12 cat breeds and 25 dog breeds, with 7,349 images in total. In contrast to CUB-200, the dataset does not provide part-level keypoint annotations, but includes pixel-level segmentation masks separating the foreground pet from the background. We therefore evaluate background reliance using the background saliency fraction, F b ​ g F_{bg} , together with the perturbation-based faithfulness metrics. For the captioning objective, we use an augmented version of the dataset in which image captions describing the foreground pet and surrounding scene are generated using BLIP-2 [ Li et al., 2023 ] . We use an 80–10–10 train-validation-test split of the original dataset.

7 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present a controlled empirical framework for analyzing multitask transferability from image captioning to fine-grained classification through explainability-based quantification of learned visual representations. Using CUB-200 as the primary benchmark, we compare classification- and caption-tuned Vision Transformer encoders under a two-stage protocol: task-specific base tuning followed by shared downstream classification finetuning under matched optimization budgets. This design enables attribution-level comparison of supervision regimes while controlling for architecture, downstream task, and compute.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个可控的经验框架,通过基于可解释性的量化方法,分析从图像标题到精细分类的多任务可转移性。 我们以CUB-200作为主要基准,比较分级和标题调整的Visual Transformer编码器在两个阶段协议下:任务特定基调,然后在匹配优化预算下共享下游分类微调. 这种设计能够对监督制度进行归属层面的比较,同时控制结构、下游任务和计算。

blocks.en: The main contribution of this study is a multi-criteria evaluation framework that links representation transfer to measurable explanation properties. Rather than relying only on classification accuracy, we combine faithfulness-based metrics, through positive and negative perturbation AUC, with localization-based metrics, including keypoint emphasis, background attribution, and spatial-distribution alignment. This provides a structured way to quantify how different supervision modalities organize visual evidence after transfer.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献是建立一个多标准评价框架,将代表性转移与可衡量的解释属性联系起来。 我们不只依靠分类准确性,而是通过正向和负向扰动的AUC,将基于忠诚的度量衡与基于本地化的度量衡结合起来,包括关键点的强调,背景的归属,以及空间分布的对接等. 这为量化不同监督模式在转移后如何组织视觉证据提供了有条理的方法.

blocks.en: Across the main CUB-200 experiments, caption-based pretraining produces consistent advantages on most attribution-based metrics. Caption-tuned encoders show stronger correspondence to annotated keypoints, improved geometric alignment with keypoint density maps, reduced attribution to background regions, and greater sensitivity to removal of highly salient regions. Although these improvements do not translate into higher downstream classification accuracy under the fixed training budget, they reveal systematic differences in representation structure that predictive performance alone does not capture. This suggests that language supervision can shape how visual evidence is organized, even when the final task risk remains comparable. In contrast, classification tuning produces slightly greater stability under the removal of low-saliency regions.
blocks.zh: 在主要的CUB-200试验中,基于字幕的预训对大多数基于归属的衡量标准产生一致的优势。 Caption-tuned编码器显示与被注解的键点的对应性更强,与按键点密度图的几何对接性更佳,对背景区域的归属被降低,对去除高度突出区域更敏感. 虽然这些改进并没有转化为固定培训预算下游分类的更准确性,但它们揭示了代表性结构的系统性差异,仅预测性能并不能捕捉到这些差异。 这表明语言监督可以决定视觉证据的组织方式,即使最终任务风险仍然具有可比性. 相形之下,分级调和在去除低等同位素区域后产生略为较大的稳定性.

blocks.en: The ablation studies further support the utility of the framework. On Oxford-IIIT Pet, where only foreground segmentation is available, the same protocol identifies consistent supervision-dependent trends using background attribution and perturbation metrics. The ViT-L/16 encoder-scale ablation preserves the directional patterns observed with ViT-B/16, indicating that the analysis is not tied to a single encoder capacity. Together, these experiments show that the proposed framework can be applied across datasets, annotation granularities, and model scales to quantify how training objectives affect learned representations.
blocks.zh: 延期研究进一步支持了框架的效用。 在Oxford-IIIT Pet中,只有前地分出,同一协议利用背景归属和扰动度量度来识别一致的依赖监督的趋势. VIT-L/16编码器相位衰减保留了与VIT-B/16一起观测到的方向图案,表明分析不与单一编码器容量相接. 这些实验表明,拟议框架可适用于数据集、注释颗粒和模型尺度,以量化培训目标如何影响学到的表述。

blocks.en: Overall, the findings highlight the value of explainability-based evaluation for studying representation transfer beyond accuracy. Caption-based pretraining is not superior in downstream classification accuracy, but it induces more semantically structured attribution behavior across most evaluated criteria. This distinction is important for settings where the organization of evidence, localization of task-relevant regions, and reduced background reliance matter alongside predictive performance. Future work can extend this framework to larger-scale multimodal objectives, including contrastive vision–language learning, additional fine-grained and domain-specific datasets to further characterize how supervision modality shapes visual representations.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些结果突出了基于解释性的评价对于研究超过准确度的代表性转移的价值。 基于Caption的预训在下游分类精度方面并不优越,但它在大多数被评价的标准中诱发了更精密结构化的归属行为. 这种区别对于组织证据、确定与任务有关的区域以及减少背景依赖与预测性能相结合的情况十分重要。 今后的工作可以将这一框架扩展至更大的多模式目标,包括对比性愿景-语言学习、额外的精细和特定领域数据集,以进一步说明监督模式如何形成视觉表现。
